Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
Safety fence with caution marks surrounded the work area is required.
Transformer
 isolation and earthing is required.
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 and safety
 harness.
There
 is a danger of falling into containment pit when working near large power
 transformers.
A
 proper well-fixed ladder should be used for climbing on top of the
 transformer tank.
Tools and Equipment
Fiberglass
 ladder, dielectric strength oil tester,
Voltmeter, complete set of maintenance
 hand tools.
Safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, and safety harness.
Work to be carried out
Check
cooler valves (open)
Check
radiator valves (open)
Check
conservator valves (open).
Check
buchloz relay valve (open).
Check
radiator bank main valves (open).
Check
oil drain valve (close).
Check
oil filling valve (close).
Check
oil sampling valves (close).
Check
 gas sampling valve (close).
Check
 buchloz relay by-pass valve (close).
Check
 air bleed plugs (close).
Check
oil level tank.
Check
oil level conservator.
Check
oil level in buchloz relay.
Check
oil level in cable connection chamber.
Check
tank ground.
Check
fan/motors ground.
Check
control cabinet ground.
Check
lightning arreestors ground.
Check fan on 60 oC in oil temperature gauge and off at 50oC
Check
fan alarm 90 oC in oil temperature gauge.
Check
fan trip 110 oC in oil temperature gauge.
Check
fan on 83 oC in winding temperature gauge and off at 50oC
Check
alarm 108 oC in winding temperature gauge.
Check trip 123 oC in winding temperature gauge.
Make
air bleeding from coolers.
Make
air bleeding from radiators.
Make
air bleeding from piping.
Make
air bleeding from Pressure relief.
Make
air bleeding from buchholz relay.
Make
air bleeding from cable connection chamber.
Check
color bank radiator.
Check
fans operation.
Check
the control cabinet connections.
Check
the direction of rotation of fans.
Lubricate
fan bearing or change bearing.
Check
the terminal boxes connection.
Check
silica-gel breather and replace if the color change.
Clean
 the
cooler.
Clean
the radiators.
Clean
the bushings.
Clean
the cable connection chamber.
Clean
 the control cabinet.
Clean
the equipment.
